# Security events
{: .no_toc }

Spot attacks and lockouts.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `SEC-01` |
| **Route** | `/ops/security` |
| **Where** | Operations › Security events |
| **Who can use it** | operations.view |
| **Kind** | table |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M3 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Group by | segmented control | user · IP · key |  |
| Rows | table | failed logins, lockouts, MFA challenges, refresh-token reuse, 403 denials, `destructive_operation_restricted`, `api_key_in_browser` | user → USR-03; key → KEY-04 |
| Actions | menu | → USR-05 Suspend · USR-04 Sign out everywhere · KEY-04 Revoke | each is the normal API call, audited with the person as actor |

## Good to know

- Calls through the web Hub's backend show the backend's IP until [G5 #42](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps.com/issues/42) adds a trusted client-IP header; say so in a caption.

## For developers

Loads: `POST /ops/logs/query {template: security_events, range}` · `GET /ops/metrics?panel=security`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
